known_uncertainty.summary: Review by a qualified federal civil-discovery, attorney-client-privilege, Rule 502, mandamus, sealing, and appellate practitioner remains pending; no independent review is recorded and no level-3 or gold claim is made.

Automated schema, citation, deadline, digest, render, sealed-record, and replay checks do not establish the legal accuracy, completeness, currency, or practical realism of the authored privilege, waiver, Rule 502, mandamus, discovery, or confidentiality analysis.

Record tags, stable-anchor mappings, filing and operation bindings, and semantic classifications are authored for exact identified documents and do not generalize to novel filings, altered bytes, or unreviewed procedural circumstances.

The authored actual outcome treats the August 21 pre-suit compliance letter as disclosing remediation and outside-counsel involvement without disclosing privileged communications and rejects categorical subject-matter waiver. The January 9 Rule 502(d) order governs later disclosures and neither retroactively creates nor erases waiver from the August 21 pre-suit letter. Those are exact-record conclusions; the system does not infer privilege, waiver, fairness, work product, or Rule 502 consequences from arbitrary text.

The authored actual disposition grants the writ in part, vacates the categorical-waiver and seven-day-production provisions, denies a blanket bar on related discovery, and remands for document-specific privilege, work-product, and discovery review. Those are exact-record consequences of the frozen cited standards; the workflow does not determine extraordinary-writ entitlement, adequacy of other remedies, clear error, or remedy scope in another matter.

Each fictional source document may cite only authority issued or effective by its own date. Pre-March 23 district sources do not cite the March 23 Fourth Circuit rulebook, and In re Fluor is always identified as unpublished and nonprecedential and used only for its exact persuasive analogy; later compilations do not project later authority backward.

The record models four public/sealed disclosure pairs through fifty-two bijective stable-anchor mappings, public-default projection, exact-document session grants, revocation, and deferred per-open CAS verification. Those synthetic controls establish repository behavior for frozen bytes, not the legal propriety of sealing, privilege, or authorization in another matter, and they do not represent access to PACER, CM/ECF, or any real sealed filing.

B01-B06 are never-filed counterfactual branch artifacts on two distinct synthetic original-writ dockets. Actual-history operations, the actual disposition, and actual-record argument questions must exclude those entries even though the complete training record resolves their anchors.

The deficiency branch depends on the exact B01 omissions, a static two-calendar-day cure deadline, the exact B02 notice, and exact timely B03 cure to a live submitted endpoint. The separate B04 petition is accepted as conforming and then receives substantive summary denial without an answer or argument. These exact identity and state routes do not infer deficiency, cure, conformity, or merits from arbitrary petition prose.

The actual path serializes the exact emergency motion and response, interim stay, appearances, answer invitation, answer and reply deadlines, answer, reply, expedited-argument order, scheduled argument, and argument-held record. Those document, date, and state gates do not infer urgency, entitlement to a stay, need for an answer, briefing sufficiency, or need for argument from arbitrary filings.

The committed workflow and three canonical traces intentionally preserve exactly three source-faithful executions: actual disposition through rehearing expiration, exact deficiency and timely cure to a live submitted endpoint, and summary denial through rehearing expiration. Their union covers all thirty-seven non-reject operations; the eight reject operations are hostile-tested rather than represented as canonical outcomes, and no unsupported fourth execution is claimed.

For each terminal original-writ path, the authored clerk transmits the final disposition to the trial-court judge on the judgment date under Rule 21(b)(7), calculates the exact fourteen-calendar-day Rule 40 deadline, and terminates only when that deadline is reached. Fourth Circuit guidance states that no mandate issues in an original proceeding, so the workflow contains no mandate or IssueMandate operation; this is an exact authored boundary, not a general appellate scheduling oracle.

A custom originating-court role separates district operations from appellate operations, but the fictional Fourth Circuit exercise clerk and composite panel share the generic court role. Role authorization therefore cannot distinguish clerk from panel identity beyond exact authored commands, document bindings, legal times, and trace evidence.

All parties, people, offices, addresses, dockets, identifiers, facts, communications, investigations, billing reports, and events are fictional. Compliance and health-program audit descriptions are training constructs; repository checks cannot establish external authenticity or authorize reliance as factual, legal, medical, or operational guidance.

The Alder, Vale, and Fen profiles and oral-argument behavior are fictional or composite training constructs; differentiation and deterministic replay do not model any real judge or predict actual advocacy, questioning, or outcomes.

The PDFs are generated training artifacts. Source-to-PDF checks, the accepted render inventory, and pinned hashes document repository provenance but cannot establish external authenticity, future cross-render byte determinism, or complete accessibility and typography quality.
